description: Rasterise an SVG to a crisp PNG: scale (1×, 2×, 3×, 4×… default 2×), a target width or height (aspect kept), or an exact size (stretched). Units (px, pt, mm, cm, in) and viewBox-only SVGs are understood; transparent background or a solid colour. Scripts, event handlers and external references are removed first. Name <name>@2x.png. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/svg-to-png/

background.description: Background colour when transparent is false. Default #ffffff.

height.description: Height in px for modes height / exact.

mode.description: How to size the PNG. Default scale.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

svg.description: The SVG: a local path or base64 / data URI.

transparent.description: Keep the background transparent. Default true.

width.description: Width in px for modes width / exact.

name: image_svg_to_png
title: SVG to PNG
